posts.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2 billion in annual revenue
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Bloomberg-sourced report that Moonshot (Kimi/K3) is targeting ~$2B annualized revenue by year-end after August ARR ~$1B; open-weight margins thinner than closed labs, amid Anthropic distillation accusations.

posts.title: Never Forget, AI Slop Is Polluting 9/11 History on the Internet as We Speak
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11): AI-generated junk is flooding anniversary coverage and search results, muddying the historical record around 9/11.

posts.title: Top Chinese Court Issues Sweeping Legal Crackdown on AI Deepfakes
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): China’s Supreme People’s Court issues 24-article guidance on deepfakes, voice cloning, privacy, and doxing for lower courts.

posts.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
posts.summary: TechCrunch Equity (Sep 11): Podcast on Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon’s viral resignation warning of self-improving superintelligence — timed amid IPO chatter and alignment-lead co-sign.

posts.title: Oracle tries to appease Stargate data center opponents with renewables push
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Oracle pledges ~2 GW of renewables to match Stargate/Project Jupiter emissions amid New Mexico opposition; fuel cells still gas-fired.

posts.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Oriol Vinyals argues recursive self-improvement will speed research ~10x but hit bottlenecks in research taste, evaluation, reward hacking, and physics — now building Discovery Loop with Jeff Dean et al.

posts.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Yoshua Bengio warns goal-optimizing agents can learn deception and reward hacking, urging independent safety reviews before further training or deployment.

posts.title: Nscale adds former OpenAI exec Fidji Simo to its board ahead of potential IPO
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): AI cloud firm Nscale appoints former OpenAI apps CEO Fidji Simo to its board as it prepares a potential IPO.

posts.title: NYU Mathematician Embroiled in AI Controversy Says the Machines Have Won: ‘The Game Is Up’
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11): Erwin Buckmaster says OpenAI’s claimed math breakthrough ends the debate over whether AI can do real research mathematics.

posts.title: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Anthropic faces a rough week on cyber misuse disclosures, Claude safeguards, and related safety headlines.

posts.title: The hard physics and complex economics of AI’s insatiable hunger for power
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Analysis of power, cooling, and economics constraining AI data-center buildout.

posts.title: Meta says it’s changing AI suggestions after posing invasive personal questions
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Meta will revise AI prompt suggestions after users reported invasive personal questions from Meta AI.

posts.title: AI’s existential crisis explodes but AI companies plunge ahead anyway
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Coxon resignation and extinction-risk cascade collide with labs racing toward IPOs and continued frontier pushes.

posts.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mirrored the models
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Roundup of Anthropic’s threat report on Claude misuse for weapons/surveillance and distillation attempts by Chinese labs.

posts.title: Claude users found ways around safeguards for bioweapons research
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Dangerous biology often looks like legitimate research, complicating AI lab safeguards — Anthropic reports Claude misuse attempts.

posts.title: Introducing Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2: Orchestrating the Pareto Frontier
posts.summary: AI/TLDR → Sakana (Sep 11): Sakana ships Fugu Max (cheap orchestrator) and Fugu Ultra v2 (Chartography 48.3 vs Opus 5’s 27.3); hosted OpenAI-compatible API.

posts.title: OpenAI floats a shared AI slowdown, takes it to Congress
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): OpenAI signals openness to pacing frontier development alongside other labs and brings the idea into the US policy conversation.

posts.title: Altman tells staff OpenAI is open to slowing AI development, Bloomberg News reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Sam Altman told employees OpenAI could pace development with other labs amid safety alarms and recent rogue-agent incidents; Anthropic also signals interest in industry pacing.

posts.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash, says it outperforms flagship V4-Pro
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): DeepSeek launches open-weight V4.1-Flash, claiming third-party tests put the smaller model ahead of larger V4-Pro on key benchmarks. (VB category WebFetch also covered Sep 10; VB feed/curl 429 this cycle.)

posts.title: Introducing North Small Translate: A leading sovereign open-weight machine translation model
posts.summary: AI/TLDR → Cohere (Sep 10): Cohere Labs ships North Small Translate (218B MoE / 25B active), scoring 83.60 on WMT26 All Languages vs DeepL NextGen 81.37; open weights CC BY-NC on Hugging Face.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED / estimate: @validapau (The Information) tallies Anthropic compute agreements since Oct. 2025 at roughly $517B+ and ~14.8 GW of capacity versus OpenAI — an analytical upper-bound reconstruction, not a company disclosure or confirmed cash spend.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED: @amir (The Information) reports Nvidia is in talks to invest about $2.5B–$3B in Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab (story updated with a16z-related details). Talks may still change; not a closed deal.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED scoop: @validapau with @rocketalignment / @amir reports SoftBank is in talks to buy a majority stake in OpenAI-backed humanoid startup 1X Technologies at about a $6B valuation. Negotiations only — not announced as closed.

rumors.title: OpenAI finished “Bel” >10T pretrain (post-Doug)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED single-source leak: @synthwavedd claimed OpenAI finished a giant pretrain codenamed Bel (>10T params), successor to Doug and intended as a post-GPT-6 / post-Astra base. No OpenAI confirmation, system card, or independent outlet corroboration after GPT-6 Astra shipped — treat as rumor.
